name: What are the common signs of a hidden water leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a hidden water leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a hidden water leak include an unexplained increase in your water bill, visible water stains on walls or ceilings, peeling paint, or warped flooring. You might also notice a musty odor, indicating mold growth, or hear the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. A sudden drop in water pressure can also signal a leak somewhere in your plumbing system. Recognizing these indicators promptly can help prevent extensive damage and enable a faster resolution by professionals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for unexplained high water bills, water stains, peeling paint, musty odors, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are on.
